svg.title: Blink’s serving stack, layer by layer
svg.desc: Logical exploded view. BlueField separates prompt and reply staging. RDMA writes fill slots in GPU memory. Parallel scanning claims a slot, then the GPU scheduler selects a captured graph and extends a decode batch. Sampled tokens return through the shared queue. The layers depict software responsibilities, not chip packaging.
svg.text: BlueField streams the reply as the GPU schedules the next token.
